_comment: Curated, client-facing API change log. Generated diffs from tools/api-tracker/apitrack.py are reviewed by a human and written up here before the page is rebuilt. Impact values: breaking | review | additive | docs. Never add an entry that is not backed by a snapshot diff or a confirmed change from engineering.

entries.title: Changes to endpoints you may already be calling
entries.summary: POST /api/v3/user/:userUUID/rate: request field removed: userUuid, uuid.

entries.title: Changes worth checking against your integration
entries.summary: POST /api/v3/user/:userUUID/rate: new request field: rateDetails[].dailyRate, rateDetails[].hourlyRate, rateDetails[].pagesRate.

entries.title: New endpoints and fields
entries.summary: DELETE /api/v3/project/:ProjectUUID/work-unit/bulk: new endpoint in Projects; GET /api/v3/net-rate-settings/:netRateUuid: new endpoint in Net Rate; GET /api/v3/price-list: new endpoint in Price List; POST /api/v3/user/:userUUID/rate: 200 - Success response field added: orgUnitUuid, rateDetails[].dailyRate, rateDetails[].hourlyRate, rateDetails[].pagesRate, rateDetails[].userRateUuid, rateDetails[].uuid, userUuid, uuid.

entries.title: Documentation updates
entries.summary: GET /api/v3/user/:userUUID/rate: moved section: Users to Users / Rates; POST /api/v3/user/:userUUID/rate: description text changed; POST /api/v3/user/:userUUID/rate: moved section: Users to Users / Rates; PUT /api/v3/user/:userUUID/rate/:userRateUUID: description text changed; PUT /api/v3/user/:userUUID/rate/:userRateUUID: moved section: Users to Users / Rates; PUT /api/v3/user/:userUUID/rate/:userRateUUID: renamed: Create User Rate Copy to Update User Rate.

entries.title: New endpoints and fields
entries.summary: GET /api/v3/user/:userUUID/rate: new endpoint in Users; POST /api/v3/user/:userUUID/rate: new endpoint in Users; PUT /api/v3/user/:userUUID/rate/:userRateUUID: new endpoint in Users.

entries.title: Change tracking starts here
entries.summary: We started tracking the wxrks API surface today, covering 148 documented endpoints across 19 sections along with their parameters, request bodies and response shapes. This entry is the baseline rather than a change. From here on, anything that moves in the API gets an entry on this page.
